extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: ArtifactsBench is a benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation. It contains 1,825 diverse tasks across nine domains to assess the visual fidelity and interactive integrity of LLM-generated executable artifacts.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.citeAs: Tencent Hunyuan Team. ArtifactsBench: Bridging the Visual-Interactive Gap in LLM Code Generation Evaluation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2507.04952, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was curated via a multi-stage pipeline that aggregated candidates from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots, which were then rewritten and refined by experts and LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Experts rewrote prompts for clarity, completeness, and executability, and humans verified LLM-rewritten prompts. Checklists were LLM-drafted and human-refined. For validation, multiple front-end engineers independently scored queries following a double-blind protocol where annotators remained unaware of MLLM scores and samples appeared in randomized order.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The final human ground-truth score represents the median of the individual annotators' ratings. Inter-annotator agreement was measured using Cohen's kappa and Pair ACC.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Discrete sampling of screenshots may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions; focuses on evaluating the final artifact generated in a single turn and does not assess an LLM's capability to function as an autonomous agent that can iteratively refine an artifact.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset is explicitly filtered to be privacy-free and avoid requesting or involving any sensitive personal information, such as phone numbers, addresses, or other identifiable details.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts; accelerating the development of user-centric generative models.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Experts rewrite for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Flagged items from de-duplication are re-authored.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items. Two-stage filtering for de-duplication and contamination control uses MinHash and semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS, alongside screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts.
